descriptionEn: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin Recharging Energy Shield and gain a Buff for a duration that prevents that Recharge being interrupted. The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.
summaryPt: Aura que dá uma skill pra começar a recarregar Energy Shield na hora, com um buff que impede a recarga de ser interrompida. Some quando o ES enche.
